publisher_name: The Capilano Review Contemporary Arts Society
independence_evidence: Masthead names the publisher as The Capilano Review Contemporary Arts Society, a non-profit with its own board; the about page says it has been an independent publication since leaving Capilano College in 2015.
qualifies_reason: Independent non-profit Vancouver literary and art journal publishing two print issues a year, with Spring 2025 through Fall 2026 issues on sale in its own shop.
what_it_is: A Vancouver journal of experimental writing and contemporary art, running since 1972, that pairs poetry, fiction and essays with full-colour artist projects, interviews and reviews. Issues are often themed or guest-edited (recent ones on speculative feminisms, dedications to the poet Roy Miki, and prison abolition) and draw on West Coast and Indigenous writers alongside international contributors. It is for readers of avant-garde Canadian literature and visual art who want a print journal with a strong art section.
